messages:
maria: noticed a jump in fncall validator rejects in us-west canary at ~10:12 UTC. customers hit payment_tool errors. :grimacing:
ajay: sample? strict validate or parse?
maria: strict-validate. sample log: validator=v2 fncall=xyz123 route=canary-usw outcome=REJECT reason=TYPE_MISMATCH field=payment.amount expected=string got=number
ajay: looks like model returned numbers for enum/string fields. saw ~30% reroute to text-fallback which increases token spend.
sam: which route gets billed after reroute? affects quotas.
ajay: final route (text-fallback) is billed today. origin route shows a reject count but token usage is on final route  causing misattributed cost.
maria: ops sees spend spike but canary quota unchanged. customers confused.
dev-console: propose adding fncall.validation.reason_id and routing.final_route_id fields; and a fncall.validation.soft_pass boolean. can add dashboard columns and filters quickly.
ajay: agree. short-term mitigation: enable soft-validate on the canary (tag + pass) and increase DLQ sampling from 1% to 20% for this slice so we can capture payloads.
sam: need reconciliation for billing: emit metric fncall.cost.attributed{origin_route,final_route} so finance can attribute cost back to origin when soft-pass is on.
billing-bot: finance: ok with reconciliation field, need RFC for ingest change.
maria: action plan: ajay to flip soft-validate toggle + add tags and sampling by 10:30; dev-console add dashboard filter and small badge showing soft-validate active; sam to monitor billing impact and schedule 15m post-mortem at 11:00.
ajay: will do and open RFC for reason enums & migration.
dev-console: will wire alert rule: if reject_rate >= 0.5% AND fallback_rate >= 10% during rollout -> create alert and attach runbook.
maria: add a note to the rollout doc recommending permissive validation on canaries until coercion rules are hardened.
ajay: will also add unit tests for enum coercion and timestamp normalization in validator v2.
maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
